items.t: Head gasket leaks oil or coolant
items.job: Replace head gasket; resurface head as needed

items.t: Automatic transmission failure or stuck in one gear
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: If a speed sensor or solenoid pack is at fault, the repair is a few hundred dollars.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak and start an engine fire (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering hose (recall)
items.note: Out of recall, replacing a power steering hose is a costly repair; ask for a written quote.

items.t: Timing belt breaks if not replaced on schedule
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump
items.note: If the belt already broke and bent valves, owners report about $3,000.

items.t: Misfire from leaking spark plug tube seals
items.job: Replace spark plug tube seals, valve cover gasket and plugs

items.t: Stalling when warm or won't start
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace failed sensor or fuel pump

items.t: Brakes pull left, wear fast or pulse
items.job: Replace front pads and rotors; correct brake line routing

items.t: Clunk or rattle in the steering from a loose shaft bolt
items.job: Tighten or replace steering shaft coupling pinch bolt

items.t: Power steering moan or whine
items.job: Power steering fluid flush or high-pressure hose replacement

items.t: Popping in the front end from worn tie rods
items.job: Replace tie rod ends and align

items.t: Lower ball joint can separate (recall)
items.job: Lower ball joint recall repair
items.note: Out of recall, a ball joint or lower control arm is a paid part per side, plus labor.

items.t: Some aftermarket ball joints and control arms can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket ball joint or control arm (parts maker recall)

items.t: Some replacement fuel pumps can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket fuel pump (parts maker recall)

items.t: Some replacement fuel filters can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket fuel filter (parts maker recall)

items.t: Car can roll away after shifting to Park (recall)
items.job: Shifter and ignition-park interlock recall repair

items.t: Key-shift interlock can stop working (recall)
items.job: Adjust interlock cable or replace shift button pin (recall)

items.t: Rear brake line can rub and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace and reroute rear brake tube (recall)

items.t: Front brake line bracket can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake tube bracket (recall)

items.t: Brake master cylinder can leak (recall)
items.job: Master cylinder recall repair

items.t: ABS valve can stick and make the car pull (recall)
items.job: ABS hydraulic unit recall repair

items.t: Hood may not stay latched (recall)
items.job: Secondary hood latch recall repair

items.t: Child seat tether instructions missing (recall)
items.job: Owner's manual supplement (recall)

items.t: Fuel tank straps may be unpainted and rust (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel tank straps (recall)

items.t: Rusted fuel filler tube can break
items.job: Replace fuel filler neck

items.t: Rough running at start-up and high emissions
items.job: Reflash or replace engine computer
items.note: May be covered under the federal emissions warranty if the car were newer; today it is usually paid out of pocket.

items.t: Horn sounds by itself when turning
items.job: Replace clockspring or horn contact
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $367–$418 to replace the clockspring.

items.t: Radiator failure
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant

items.t: Weak keyless entry range
items.job: Replace keyless entry receiver antenna

items.t: Water leaks in through the doors
items.job: Reseal door water shields
